rules: Repository observations and hosted technical runs require no fabricated approval records.

Release-gate qualification requires definition, campaign, and releaseGate approvals bound to exact aggregate hashes and accepted by an authenticated approver verifier; without that verifier releaseGate fails closed.
Approval identity and timestamps are observed campaign facts and are never prefilled in definitions.
Expired at validation time, pending, rejected, future-dated, or pre-evidence approvals do not satisfy a release gate.
No approval or waiver may override a non-waivable safety invariant.
Adopting an initial package set as a future baseline requires a separate real hash-bound approval, governed monotonic registry, authenticated verifier, and revalidated hosted source campaign/archive.
